tools/runtime/build-native.sh.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
source "$root/tools/runtime/pins.env"
toolchain=${POCKETLORE_TOOLCHAIN:-/home/isa/Android/atlas-toolchain}
src="$root/downloads/runtime/llama.cpp"
[[ $(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD) == "$LLAMA_REVISION" ]]
[[ -z $(git -C "$src" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
cmp "$src/LICENSE" "$root/android/app/src/main/assets/licenses/llama.cpp.txt"
src=$(python3 "$root/tools/runtime/sparse/prepare_native.py")
for abi in arm64-v8a x86_64; do
  build="$root/downloads/native-cache-build/android/$abi"
  "$toolchain/cmake-3.22.1/bin/cmake" -S "$root/android/app/src/main/cpp" -B "$build" \
    -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$toolchain/android-ndk-r27c/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake" \
    -DANDROID_ABI="$abi" -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-28 -DANDROID_STL=c++_static \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON \
    -DLLAMA_SOURCE="$src" -DPOCKETLORE_REVISION="$LLAMA_REVISION"
  "$toolchain/cmake-3.22.1/bin/cmake" --build "$build" --target pocketlore --parallel "${POCKETLORE_BUILD_JOBS:-2}"
  mkdir -p "$root/android/app/build/generated/nativeLibs/$abi"
  cp "$build/libpocketlore.so" "$root/android/app/build/generated/nativeLibs/$abi/"
  "$toolchain/android-ndk-r27c/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-strip" --strip-unneeded "$root/android/app/build/generated/nativeLibs/$abi/libpocketlore.so"
done

android/app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt.text:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(pocketlore_native LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(flag LLAMA_BUILD_COMMON LLAMA_BUILD_TESTS LLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS LLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES LLAMA_BUILD_SERVER LLAMA_BUILD_APP LLAMA_BUILD_UI LLAMA_OPENSSL GGML_NATIVE GGML_OPENMP GGML_CUDA GGML_VULKAN GGML_RPC GGML_BLAS GGML_LLAMAFILE GGML_CPU_KLEIDIAI GGML_AVX GGML_AVX2 GGML_FMA GGML_F16C GGML_BMI2 GGML_SSE42)
    set(${flag} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(GGML_CPU_ARM_ARCH armv8-a CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${LLAMA_SOURCE}" llama)
add_library(pocketlore SHARED runtime.cpp sparse_link.cpp)
target_link_libraries(pocketlore PRIVATE llama)
target_compile_definitions(pocketlore PRIVATE POCKETLORE_REVISION="${POCKETLORE_REVISION}")

# Memory accounting API belongs to the exact immutable pinned llama.cpp revision.
target_include_directories(pocketlore PRIVATE "${LLAMA_SOURCE}/src")

# NDK r27: align LOAD and RELRO for both 4 KB and 16 KB Android kernels.
target_link_options(pocketlore PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384" "-Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384")

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(pocketlore_sparse_host LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(flag LLAMA_BUILD_COMMON LLAMA_BUILD_TESTS LLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS LLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES LLAMA_BUILD_SERVER LLAMA_BUILD_APP LLAMA_BUILD_UI LLAMA_OPENSSL GGML_OPENMP GGML_CUDA GGML_VULKAN GGML_RPC GGML_BLAS GGML_LLAMAFILE GGML_NATIVE)
 set(${flag} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
add_subdirectory("${LLAMA_SOURCE}" llama)
add_executable(sparse-host host.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sparse-host PRIVATE llama)

target_include_directories(sparse-host PRIVATE "${LLAMA_SOURCE}/src")
add_executable(native-cache-controls native_controls.cpp)
target_include_directories(native-cache-controls PRIVATE "${LLAMA_SOURCE}/src")
target_link_libraries(native-cache-controls PRIVATE llama)

tools/runtime/build-native.sh.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
source "$root/tools/runtime/pins.env"
toolchain=${POCKETLORE_TOOLCHAIN:-/home/isa/Android/atlas-toolchain}
src="$root/downloads/runtime/llama.cpp"
[[ $(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD) == "$LLAMA_REVISION" ]]
[[ -z $(git -C "$src" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) ]]
cmp "$src/LICENSE" "$root/android/app/src/main/assets/licenses/llama.cpp.txt"
src=$(python3 "$root/tools/runtime/sparse/prepare_native.py")
for abi in arm64-v8a x86_64; do

"""Validate real native receipts and linked artifacts; no model execution here."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,zipfile
R=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];p=R/'docs/evidence/native-cache-lifecycle-review.json'
hashfile=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def validate(d,require_current=True):
 assert d['status']=='HOST_CONTROLS_PASS_LINKED_ANDROID_PENDING',d['status']
 assert not d['inference'] and not d['full_model_load']
 assert d['model_payload_bytes']==12582912
 for n,v in d['source'].items():
  assert v['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(v['text'].encode()).hexdigest(),n
  if require_current:assert hashfile(R/n)==v['sha256'],n
 assert {x['name'] for x in d['results']}=={'fixture','model'}
 for x in d['results']:
  assert x['exit']==0 and x['end']>x['start']
  if require_current:assert x['binary_sha256']==hashfile(R/'downloads/native-cache-build/host/native-cache-controls')
  lines=[json.loads(l) for l in d['raw'][x['name']+'.log'].splitlines() if l.startswith('{')]
  expected={'unaligned','oversized','absent-map','async-reader','nested-owner','partial-map','cancelled','closed-map','alias-mapping','live-lifetime'}
  if x['name']=='fixture':expected|={'wrong-size','wrong-hash','deadline','renamed','wrong-inode'}
  assert expected<={r.get('control') for r in lines if r.get('refused') is True}
  assert any(r.get('control')=='mapped-pread-after-advice' and r.get('pass') is True for r in lines)
  a=json.loads(d['raw'][x['name']+'-resident.json']);b=json.loads(d['raw'][x['name']+'-released.json'])
  for k in ['pid','startticks','fd','stat_device','inode','bytes','sha256','mount','namespaces']:assert a[k]==b[k],k
  assert a['pid']>0 and int(a['startticks'])>0 and a['inode']>0
  assert a['monotonic_ns']<b['monotonic_ns']
  assert a['regions']==[{**b['regions'][0],'cache_present_pages':a['regions'][0]['cache_present_pages']}]
  for observation in [a,b]:
   region=observation['regions'][0];assert region['bytes']==4194304 and region['offset']==0
   mount_device=tuple(map(int,observation['mount'].split()[2].split(':')))
   blocks=re.split(r'(?=^[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+ )',observation['smaps'],flags=re.M)
   matched=[]
   for block in blocks:
    if not block.strip():continue
    header=block.splitlines()[0].split()
    if '-' not in header[0]:continue
    lo,hi=(int(v,16) for v in header[0].split('-'))
    if lo==region['address']:
     assert hi-lo==region['bytes'] and header[1]=='r--s'
     assert int(header[2],16)==region['offset'] and tuple(int(v,16) for v in header[3].split(':'))==mount_device
     assert int(header[4])==observation['inode']
     fields={k:int(v)*1024 for k,v in re.findall(r'^(Rss|Pss|Private_Clean|Private_Dirty|Anonymous|Swap):\s+(\d+) kB$',block,re.M)}
     assert fields['Pss']<=fields['Rss']<=region['bytes'] and fields['Anonymous']==fields['Swap']==fields['Private_Dirty']==0
     assert region['cache_present_pages']*region['page_size']>=fields['Rss']
     matched.append(fields)
   assert len(matched)==1
   observation['independently_parsed_mapping_bytes']=matched[0]
  assert a['independently_parsed_mapping_bytes']['Rss']==4194304
  assert b['independently_parsed_mapping_bytes']['Rss']==0

  if x['name']=='model':assert a['sha256']=='96b9c0af5c77a4ecaabe3983175112b5ece763261c1ece12b2494b692a70dad7' and a['bytes']==12290628576
  samples=json.loads(d['raw'][x['name']+'-live.json']);assert samples and all(v['pid']==a['pid'] for v in samples)
  for v in samples:
   assert x['start']<=v['epoch']<=x['end']
   assert int(v['memory.current'])<8053063680,'Prior 7.5GiB aggregate stop exceeded'
 assert int(d['raw']['before/memory.max'])<=9663676416 and int(d['raw']['before/memory.swap.max'])==0
 assert int(d['raw']['before/pids.max'])<=512
 quota,period=map(int,d['raw']['before/cpu.max'].split());assert quota<=period*2
 return True
def alter_mapping(d,key,value):
 j=json.loads(d['raw']['model-resident.json']);j['regions'][0][key]=value
 d['raw']['model-resident.json']=json.dumps(j)
try:
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());validate(d,False)
 negatives=[]
 for name,mutate in [('missing-model',lambda x:x['results'].pop()),('false-inference',lambda x:x.update(inference=True)),('missing-source',lambda x:x['source']['tools/runtime/sparse/host.cpp'].update(sha256='0'*64)),('missing-live',lambda x:x['raw'].update({'model-live.json':'[]'})),('bad-hash',lambda x:x['raw'].update({'model-resident.json':x['raw']['model-resident.json'].replace('96b9c0af','00000000')})),('false-cache-zero',lambda x:alter_mapping(x,'cache_present_pages',0)),('wrong-offset',lambda x:alter_mapping(x,'offset',4096)),('foreign-address',lambda x:alter_mapping(x,'address',4096))]:
  copy=json.loads(json.dumps(d));mutate(copy)
  try:validate(copy,False)
  except (AssertionError,KeyError,ValueError):negatives.append(name);continue
  raise AssertionError('Corrupt packet passed: '+name)
 d['historical_receipt_mutation_refusals']=negatives
 validate(d,True)
 # Build cache must point to the exact immutable derivation used by current code.
 prepare=subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,str(R/'tools/runtime/sparse/prepare_native.py')],text=True,timeout=90).strip()
 cache=(R/'downloads/native-cache-build/host/CMakeCache.txt').read_text();assert 'LLAMA_SOURCE:UNINITIALIZED='+prepare in cache or 'LLAMA_SOURCE:PATH='+prepare in cache
 derived=pathlib.Path(prepare);manifest=json.loads((derived.parent/'native-manifest.json').read_text())
 d['derivation']={'manifest_sha256':hashfile(derived.parent/'native-manifest.json'),'input_sha256':manifest['input_sha256'],'executed_mmap_source':(derived/'src/llama-mmap.cpp').read_text(),'pinned_revision':'bb4caa7540188872173c44d161602d9271386413'}
 artifacts={};readelf='/home/isa/Android/atlas-toolchain/android-ndk-r27c/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-readelf'
 for abi in ['arm64-v8a','x86_64']:
  path=R/f'android/app/build/generated/nativeLibs/{abi}/libpocketlore.so';assert path.is_file()
  headers=subprocess.check_output([readelf,'-lW',str(path)],text=True,timeout=15)
  loads=[l for l in headers.splitlines() if l.lstrip().startswith('LOAD')];assert loads and all(int(l.split()[-1],16)>=16384 for l in loads)
  assert prepare in (R/f'downloads/native-cache-build/android/{abi}/CMakeCache.txt').read_text()
  artifacts[abi]={'sha256':hashfile(path),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'program_headers':headers}
 apks=list((R/'android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug').glob('*.apk'));assert len(apks)==1
 with zipfile.ZipFile(apks[0]) as z:
  for abi,v in artifacts.items():assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(f'lib/{abi}/libpocketlore.so')).hexdigest()==v['sha256']
 artifacts['apk']={'sha256':hashfile(apks[0]),'bytes':apks[0].stat().st_size}
 d['linked_artifacts']=artifacts;d['receipt_mutation_refusals']=negatives;d['check_result']='PASS_NATIVE_ENGINEERING_ONLY'
except Exception as e:
 if 'd' not in locals():d=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {}
 d['check_result']='FAIL: '+str(e)
finally:
 # Freeze current code and available build/control logs even when historical
 # source binding fails. Failure evidence must be independently inspectable.
 current_paths=list(d.get('source',{}))+['tools/evaluation/native-cache/check.py','tools/evaluation/check_native_cache_lifecycle.sh','tools/runtime/sparse/profile.h','tools/runtime/sparse/identity.json','tools/runtime/sparse/lazy-mmap.patch']
 d['final_current_source']={n:{'sha256':hashfile(R/n),'text':(R/n).read_text()} for n in dict.fromkeys(current_paths) if (R/n).is_file()}
 logs=R/'downloads/native-cache-build/final-logs'
 d['independent_criticism']=json.loads((R/'docs/evidence/native-cache-inputs/independent-review.json').read_text())
 d['final_build_control_receipts']={n.name:{'sha256':hashfile(n),'text':n.read_text()} for n in sorted(logs.glob('*')) if n.is_file() and n.suffix in ['.log','.txt','.exit','.json']}
 d['final_linked_artifact_observations']={}
 cache=R/'downloads/native-cache-build/host/CMakeCache.txt'
 if cache.is_file():
  selected=next((line.split('=',1)[1] for line in cache.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('LLAMA_SOURCE:')),None)
  if selected:
   base=pathlib.Path(selected);manifest=base.parent/'native-manifest.json'
   d['final_derivation']={'manifest_sha256':hashfile(manifest),'manifest':json.loads(manifest.read_text()),'mmap_source':(base/'src/llama-mmap.cpp').read_text()}

 readelf='/home/isa/Android/atlas-toolchain/android-ndk-r27c/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-readelf'
 paths=[R/'downloads/native-cache-build/host/native-cache-controls',R/'downloads/native-cache-build/host/sparse-host']+[R/f'android/app/build/generated/nativeLibs/{abi}/libpocketlore.so' for abi in ['arm64-v8a','x86_64']]+list((R/'android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug').glob('*.apk'))
 for artifact in paths:
  if artifact.is_file():
   item={'sha256':hashfile(artifact),'bytes':artifact.stat().st_size}
   if artifact.suffix!='.apk':item['program_headers']=subprocess.check_output([readelf,'-lW',str(artifact)],text=True,timeout=15)
   d['final_linked_artifact_observations'][str(artifact.relative_to(R))]=item

 d['executed_checker']={'text' :pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),'sha256':hashfile(pathlib.Path(__file__))}

"""Validate real native receipts and linked artifacts; no model execution here."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,zipfile
R=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];p=R/'docs/evidence/native-cache-lifecycle-review.json'
hashfile=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def validate(d,require_current=True):
 assert d['status']=='HOST_CONTROLS_PASS_LINKED_ANDROID_PENDING',d['status']
 assert not d['inference'] and not d['full_model_load']
 assert d['model_payload_bytes']==12582912
 for n,v in d['source'].items():
  assert v['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(v['text'].encode()).hexdigest(),n
  if require_current:assert hashfile(R/n)==v['sha256'],n
 assert {x['name'] for x in d['results']}=={'fixture','model'}
 for x in d['results']:
  assert x['exit']==0 and x['end']>x['start']
  if require_current:assert x['binary_sha256']==hashfile(R/'downloads/native-cache-build/host/native-cache-controls')
  lines=[json.loads(l) for l in d['raw'][x['name']+'.log'].splitlines() if l.startswith('{')]
  expected={'unaligned','oversized','absent-map','async-reader','nested-owner','partial-map','cancelled','closed-map','alias-mapping','live-lifetime'}
  if x['name']=='fixture':expected|={'wrong-size','wrong-hash','deadline','renamed','wrong-inode'}
  assert expected<={r.get('control') for r in lines if r.get('refused') is True}
  assert any(r.get('control')=='mapped-pread-after-advice' and r.get('pass') is True for r in lines)
  a=json.loads(d['raw'][x['name']+'-resident.json']);b=json.loads(d['raw'][x['name']+'-released.json'])
  for k in ['pid','startticks','fd','stat_device','inode','bytes','sha256','mount','namespaces']:assert a[k]==b[k],k
  assert a['pid']>0 and int(a['startticks'])>0 and a['inode']>0
  assert a['monotonic_ns']<b['monotonic_ns']
  assert a['regions']==[{**b['regions'][0],'cache_present_pages':a['regions'][0]['cache_present_pages']}]
  for observation in [a,b]:
   region=observation['regions'][0];assert region['bytes']==4194304 and region['offset']==0
   mount_device=tuple(map(int,observation['mount'].split()[2].split(':')))
   blocks=re.split(r'(?=^[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+ )',observation['smaps'],flags=re.M)
   matched=[]
   for block in blocks:
    if not block.strip():continue
    header=block.splitlines()[0].split()
    if '-' not in header[0]:continue
    lo,hi=(int(v,16) for v in header[0].split('-'))
    if lo==region['address']:
     assert hi-lo==region['bytes'] and header[1]=='r--s'
     assert int(header[2],16)==region['offset'] and tuple(int(v,16) for v in header[3].split(':'))==mount_device
     assert int(header[4])==observation['inode']
     fields={k:int(v)*1024 for k,v in re.findall(r'^(Rss|Pss|Private_Clean|Private_Dirty|Anonymous|Swap):\s+(\d+) kB$',block,re.M)}
     assert fields['Pss']<=fields['Rss']<=region['bytes'] and fields['Anonymous']==fields['Swap']==fields['Private_Dirty']==0
     assert region['cache_present_pages']*region['page_size']>=fields['Rss']
     matched.append(fields)
   assert len(matched)==1
   observation['independently_parsed_mapping_bytes']=matched[0]
  assert a['independently_parsed_mapping_bytes']['Rss']==4194304
  assert b['independently_parsed_mapping_bytes']['Rss']==0

  if x['name']=='model':assert a['sha256']=='96b9c0af5c77a4ecaabe3983175112b5ece763261c1ece12b2494b692a70dad7' and a['bytes']==12290628576
  samples=json.loads(d['raw'][x['name']+'-live.json']);assert samples and all(v['pid']==a['pid'] for v in samples)
